from itertools import permutations

n = 3
# Find a permutation of 0..n-1 where consecutive absolute differences are a permutation of 1..n-1
for perm in permutations(range(n)):
    diffs = [abs(perm[i+1] - perm[i]) for i in range(n-1)]
    if sorted(diffs) == list(range(1, n)):
        print(f"Found: {list(perm)}, differences: {diffs}")
